purpose: Discriminate net aspiration/hint value and older-request hint effectiveness after diagnostic-v1, without changing the baseline or binding TT policy.
aspiration: One-worker 2x2 existing controls (WIDEN16/full window x hints on/off) preserve all other Construction flags and Hash64. Rotated order, one excluded warmup and three measured rounds, full request accounting. Failed-window work may be valuable information production; measure net request effect rather than pass count alone. If a clear credible consumer opportunity emerges, select a bounded candidate for separate validation and clock screen; otherwise disposition this formulation without claiming universal optimality.
lifetime: Four actual CP64 comparison game trajectories selected by schedule, not outcome, in lifetime-selection.json. Fresh legal replay of every move before measurements. Requests ply16 through47, target D7 with 500k admitted-node cap. Independent white/black owners. Standard retention versus explicit existing newGame-before-request control, plus separately observed retained replica with exact full-request parity. All counts include incomplete requests and completed descendants. Controls change ordinary invocation reset only; no alternate retention policy or candidate is activated.
lifetimeTimingLimit: Retained and cleared order alternates by ply; no warmup, one replay per trajectory and observed searches interleave. Timing is descriptive only, not a clean speed claim. Node/depth/decision/age/occupancy findings are the primary lifetime discriminator. A common third-generation corpus is not independent strength evidence.
resources: One BelowNormal JVM at a time, APC4, heap768MiB. Native CPU/peak memory recorded, per-JVM 20-minute operational watchdog, per-request existing 60-second safety ceiling. Expected 3-10 minutes; preserve failure and capped output. Do not run alongside clock experiments.
analysis: All predeclared requests remain. No strength claim, no hypothesis-specific Elo threshold, no post-hoc sample extension. Summarize paired node/elapsed/CPU ratios for aspiration; compare depth and moves at fixed node budget; lifetime hint ages/current versus older hits and cumulative pressure plus retained/cleared node/depth contrasts. Defer new architectural work unless evidence justifies it.
authority: No production promotion, CP64 mutation, TT identity/layout/locking/replacement/proof-policy change or new independent objective. Runtime is a separate immutable research workspace raw/followup-v1-runtime; preserve diagnostic-v1 unchanged.
